title: E-commerce Store & Admin Dashboard
subtitle: A complete online jewellery store, with orders, payments and returns run from a phone.
_comment_package: RENAMED from 'Starter Store'. That name is a PUBLISHED TIER at ₹99,000 over
8 weeks, declared in the site's structured data, and this is a deliberately
smaller product at a lower price. Two different things cannot share a name:
a client who searched the studio mid-negotiation would find the same package
at 2.5x the price. tools/quote-doc.mjs refuses to render a quote whose
package name collides with a tier, so this cannot regress.
packageNote removed: it pointed at a tier-comparison table that has been
dropped, and repeated what the paragraph under 'What you get' already says.
_comment_price: PRICE AND ANCHOR SET BY SUMANTH, deliberately, with the floor argument heard
and overruled. ₹39,999 over 15 working days is ₹2,666/day against a ₹8,000
floor. The reasons are commercial and they are his to weigh: the studio is
short of leads, this is cash now, and the add-ons page is the way back in.
Anchor moved ₹89,999 -> ₹59,999. A ₹50,000 strike-through on a ₹39,999 job
reads as invented; ₹20,000 reads as a real discount someone decided to give.

stages.name: Kick-off
stages.what: We collect your product list, photographs, descriptions, WhatsApp number and business details.

stages.name: Design
stages.what: Home, product and checkout screens for your approval. Two rounds of revisions are included here — this is where changes are cheap.

stages.name: Build
stages.what: Storefront, admin dashboard, database and payments. Your catalogue loaded with real photographs, prices and stock.

stages.name: Review
stages.what: A private staging link. You place test orders, we fix what you find, and we walk you through the dashboard on a call.

stages.name: Launch
stages.what: Domain pointed, payment keys switched to live, sample data cleared. The shop is open.

_comment_carePlan: REMOVED from this quote, not repriced. Care is published at ₹12,500/mo and
that is the number the tool reads — a quote cannot type a cheaper one, which
is how ₹2,500 got into the last draft. But ₹12,500/mo beside a ₹39,999 build
is a bigger monthly ask than the build itself and would stall the close.
So it is simply not offered here. The 30-day warranty still applies, and the
add-ons page is the way back in.
_comment_hourly: The hourly rate is GONE. The SOW template says the studio does not bill by
the hour, and ₹900/hr was ₹7,200/day — under the floor again.
notIncluded: Drafting or reviewing your legal policies

_comment_weeks: Back to Sumanth's original 3 weeks. Five weeks made the day rate worse
(same money, more days) and delayed the cash this is being taken for.
He knows how much of the existing demo build is reusable; I do not.
